high.title: MTS 1, Software Engineer - Full Stack
high.description:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

Join eBay’s Advertising and Marketing Technology teams to build the platforms, services, and user experiences that help sellers grow their business and make eBay the destination website for existing and new customers. You’ll work on high-scale systems spanning frontend applications, backend services, APIs, data pipelines, and AI-assisted engineering workflows, partnering closely with product, design, analytics, and applied science. We’re looking for engineers who can turn business problems into reliable, maintainable software, make sound technical tradeoffs, and take ownership from design through production. This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys solving practical engineering problems in a fast-moving environment where performance, quality, and measurable customer impact matter.

Job Responsibilities



- Design and build innovative advertising, marketing platform features that help eBay sellers, advertisers grow their business and help eBay become the dominant eCommerce platform.
- Develop scalable, highly available applications, APIs, and services using technologies such as Marko, React, Node.js, Java, and Scala.
- Own end-to-end delivery of complex features, from technical design and architecture through deployment and production support.
- Drive technical decisions, system design, and cross-team collaboration to ensure scalable, reliable, and maintainable solutions.
- Leverage AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code) throughout the development lifecycle for coding, debugging, testing, and code review to increase engineering velocity.
- Contribute to AI-powered advertising and marketing features by collaborating with ML engineers on LLM integrations, recommendation systems, and intelligent campaign optimization.
- Contribute to a culture of continuous learning, Agile development, open-source collaboration, and rapid software delivery.
- Mentor team members, participate in technical discussions, and help shape engineering best practices across the organization.


Job Requirements



- BS/BA in Computer Science or related field plus 7 years work experience or MS with 6 years of relevant experience.
- Strong experience in building modern web applications at scale with React (or similar frameworks), HTML/CSS, RESTful APIs and responsive design.
- Experience with relational (Oracle/Postgres/MySQL) and/or NoSQL (Cassandra/MongoDB) databases, including schema design and query optimization.
- Proven ability to own end-to-end system design: writing technical design documents, leading design reviews, and making architectural decisions for multi-service features.
- Experience designing scalable distributed systems with a track record of evaluating trade-offs (consistency, availability, latency, cost) and driving technical alignment across teams.
- Experience with AI-assisted development practices and tools to increase engineering productivity (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or equivalent).
- Experience building or integrating LLM-powered features, agentic workflows, or AI-driven automation in production systems is a plus.
- Strong ownership mentality with ability to drive work end-to-end in a collaborative environment.
- Exposure to GraphQL and experience in building Federated GraphQL APIs is highly desirable.
- Experience on contributing to open-source is a plus.


Benefits are an essential part of your total compensation for the work you do every day. Whether you’re single, in a growing family, or nearing retirement, eBay offers a variety of comprehensive and competitive benefit programs to meet your needs. Including maternal & paternal leave, paid sabbatical, and plans to help ensure your financial security today and in the years ahead because we know feeling financially secure during your working years and through retirement is important.

Here at eBay, we love creating opportunities for others by connecting people from widely diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and geographies. So, being diverse and inclusive isn’t just something we strive for, it is who we are, and part of what we do each and every single day. We want to ensure that as an employee, you feel eBay is a place where, no matter who you are, you feel safe, included, and that you have the opportunity to bring your unique self to work. To learn about eBay’s Diversity & Inclusion click here: https://www.ebayinc.com/our-company/diversity-inclusion/

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.

medium.title: SDE I Backend Engineer
medium.description:
Backend Engineer (SDE 1)


About Astra


Astra is a cybersecurity SaaS company that makes otherwise chaotic pentests a breeze with its one-of-a-kind Pentest Platform. Astra's continuous vulnerability scanner emulates hacker behavior to scan applications for 9,300+ security tests. CTOs & CISOs love Astra because it helps them fix vulnerabilities in record time and move from DevOps to DevSecOps with Astra's CI/CD integrations.
Astra is loved by 650+ companies across the globe. In 2023, Astra uncovered 2 million+ vulnerabilities for its customers, saving customers $69M+ in potential losses due to security vulnerabilities.
We've been awarded by the President of France, Mr. François Hollande, at the La French Tech program and the Prime Minister of India, Shri Narendra Modi, at the Global Conference on Cyber Security. Loom, MamaEarth, Muthoot Finance, Canara Robeco, ScripBox, etc. are a few of Astra's customers.
Role Overview
At Astra Security, we are building the future of AI-driven cybersecurity, including Autonomous Pentesting — an experience that helps teams automatically discover, test, and secure Web & Mobile applications, Cloud, and APIs at scale.


As a Backend Engineer (SDE 1), you will work on building and improving the backend systems that power Astra's cybersecurity platform. You'll develop APIs, backend services, database components, and asynchronous workflows that support our core product.
You'll work closely with experienced backend engineers, frontend engineers, product managers, DevOps, and QA to build reliable and scalable features. You'll get hands-on experience taking features from development to production, debugging real-world issues, and learning how distributed backend systems are designed and operated at scale.
This is an opportunity to work on challenging engineering problems, contribute to 0-1 product initiatives, and grow your backend engineering skills in a fast-paced product environment.


Here's what's in it for you

- Build and maintain backend services and RESTful APIs for Astra's platform.
- Develop clean, maintainable, and reusable code following sound software engineering principles.
- Work with databases to design tables, write queries, and improve application performance.
- Build and work with asynchronous workflows using queues, events, and background processing.
- Debug production and development issues and identify the root cause of problems.
- Write unit and integration tests to ensure reliability and code quality.
- Work with AI-assisted development tools to improve engineering productivity while reviewing and validating generated code before it reaches production.
- Participate in code reviews and incorporate feedback to continuously improve your engineering practices.
- Collaborate with frontend, product, DevOps, and QA teams to deliver features.
- Contribute to improving system reliability, developer productivity, and engineering processes.
- Learn and work with modern backend and distributed-system technologies.


What we're looking for

- 1- 3 years of experience building backend applications in a product-based or SaaS environment.
- Strong proficiency in at least one backend programming language such as Java, Python, PHP, or C++.
- Good understanding of OOP, data structures, algorithms, and core software engineering principles.
- Experience building or working with RESTful APIs.
- Good understanding of relational databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL.
- Ability to write efficient SQL queries and understand basic database design.
- Basic understanding of asynchronous processing, queues, events, or background jobs.
- Familiarity with concepts such as ORMs, dependency injection, data validation, caching, logging, and error handling.
- Strong debugging and problem-solving skills.
- Good understanding of writing maintainable, testable code.
- Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS is a plus.
- Experience using AI coding tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or similar tools is a plus.
- Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.
- A strong learning mindset and willingness to take ownership of problems.


Why Astra?

- Opportunity to work on products that solve challenging real-world cybersecurity problems.
- Work on backend systems powering an AI-driven cybersecurity platform.
- Learn from experienced engineers and work closely with founders and product teams.
- Exposure to distributed systems, asynchronous processing, cloud infrastructure, and modern backend architecture.
- Ownership of features from development through production, with the right level of guidance and mentorship.
- Fast release cycles with the ability to ship code frequently.
- Collaborative engineering culture with a strong focus on learning and innovation.
- Join a team of builders and problem-solvers who thrive on first-principles thinking, move fast without breaking trust, and take pride in shipping products that matter.
- Opportunity to contribute to products from the ground up and grow rapidly as an engineer.
- Flexible hybrid work environment.
- Comprehensive health insurance for you and your family.
- Annual team off-sites and regular team events.
- A supportive, high-growth environment where your ideas and contributions can have a real impact.
Location
This is a hybrid role in Bengaluru and requires a regular in-office presence to collaborate closely with Engineering and Product teams. Being in-office helps foster deep collaboration, faster decision-making, and the shared energy of building together — values that define how we operate at Astra.
Location: Bengaluru, India

stretch.description:
Senior Software Engineer
Bengaluru, IND Technology - Application Development / Full Time / hybrid


WHO WE ARE


Genesis transforms application development in financial markets by offering a low-code platform that supercharges developers and enables organizations to build performant, secure applications with unmatched speed, efficiency, and scale.


We have the vigor and passion of a startup and the skill and experience of a scale-up, consistently refining and exploring ways to make work better for everyone.


To help us achieve our vision of reinventing the way financial market organizations build software, we are looking for people who aren’t afraid to challenge the status quo - people who are passionate about change.


If you are a self-starter with a solution-orientated mindset, you’ll find a home at Genesis.


WHAT YOU NEED & THE HATS YOU WILL WEAR


You will be an experienced Java Backend/ Full Stack Developer to join our Bangalore Team. Because the Genesis Low Code Platform brings together the best of high-performance back end and web technologies to deliver 80% reductions in time to market for development teams you will need to be experienced enough to help design and build applications and solutions using the Genesis Platform.




WHERE WE SEE THIS ROLE GOING
• While we see this role as a Java expert who will design, implement, test and maintain products built using Genesis Framework, we are also looking for someone who has a clear willingness to be adaptable and flex to new ways of working as this will be critical to remain agile and innovative
• You will be a strong collaborator and as you work through the full life cycle of software development working closely with product owners, UI/UX developers, and core engineers in an iterative process. This will allow you to build knowledge of our business, services, and client needs
• As we work to tight deadlines you will be used to setting project milestones and be responsible for keeping track of progress contributing to wider project success, and deliver software releases on time and with the expected capabilities and quality


REAL WORLD COMPETENCIES THAT MATCH OUR VALUES
• Knowledge seeker: You will have at least 3 years of Java development experience but be constantly looking to expand your knowledge in areas in and outside of your direct remit. Knowledge of front end and/or back-end Java development is crucial.
• Collaborative Influencer: Someone who is always looking to meet and discuss how things can be improved or how we can work better, whilst bringing others along with you.
• Fearless Technical Expert: You will have high competence in at least two of JavaScript, TypeScript, Angular, Vue, React as well as CSS/SaSS, WPF NoSQL database systems (MongoDB, Aerospike, etc.) Relational databases (e.g. Oracle, MS SQL, Postgress).
BENEFITS | WE HELP OUR PEOPLE THRIVE


At Genesis, we recognize that taking care means looking after the whole self, both at and awayfrom the office. We are committed to enhancing the well-being of our team members through flexible, individualized benefits.


· Competitive salary and a stake in the company’s success through a defined bonus
· 18 days per year plus public holidays.
· Top-level covers private medical healthcare insurance covering Dependents
· A healthy remote working allowance to help set up your home office
· A dedicated training allowance with access to a great portfolio of training providers
· An annual wellbeing allowance to spend on anything that will benefit your mental and/or physical wellbeing
· Hybrid Working – We encourage you to work from the office a minimum of one or two days per week
· A stake in our success through our Employee Equity Scheme


We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

stretch.title: MERN Developer
stretch.description:
Job Description:

Job Description – MERN Developer /Senior Software Engineer

Experience Range- 3-5 Years

Location- Bangalore, Pune, Mumbai

Job Summary:

We are looking for a skilled MERN developer with 3–5 years of experience in building scalable, high-quality web applications using the MERN stack. The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience with MongoDB, React.js, Node.js, TypeScript, GraphQL, and NestJS, along with a solid understanding of software design principles and modern engineering practices.

The role involves working independently on software development initiatives, collaborating with cross-functional teams and clients, and contributing to the design, development, testing, deployment, and continuous improvement of applications.

Job Responsibilities:



- Develop, enhance, and maintain scalable software applications using the MERN stack, NestJS, and GraphQL. 
- Work independently with a broader understanding of project objectives, architecture, and business requirements. 
- Participate in requirements analysis, solution design, development, unit testing, debugging, and documentation. 
- Write clean, maintainable, scalable, and high-quality code aligned with SOLID principles and established coding standards. 
- Design and implement APIs using REST and GraphQL. 
- Work with MongoDB/Mongoose and other SQL/NoSQL databases as required. 
- Troubleshoot and debug application issues, with guidance from senior team members when required. 
- Participate in technical discussions with internal teams, partners, and clients. 
- Follow established development, release, and deployment processes. 
- Contribute to code reviews, knowledge sharing, and technical documentation. 
- Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior software engineers. 
- Participate in training and knowledge-sharing initiatives. 
- Develop a strong understanding of the company's platform, products, and processes. 
- Identify opportunities for technical and process improvements and contribute to their implementation. 


Job Requirements:

Must Have:



- 3–5 years of professional software development experience. 
- Strong hands-on experience with the MERN stack:MongoDBMongooseExpress.jsReact.jsNode.js
- Strong experience with TypeScript. 
- Mandatory hands-on experience with NestJS. 
- Mandatory hands-on experience with GraphQL, including API development and integration. 
- Good understanding and practical application of SOLID principles and object-oriented design concepts. 
- Experience writing effective unit and integration tests. 
- Experience developing and consuming RESTful APIs. 
- Basic understanding of microservices architecture. 
- Knowledge of both NoSQL and SQL databases. 
- Experience with cloud-based application development and deployment. 
- Exposure to Docker and containerization. 
- Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and deployment practices. 
- Basic awareness of event-driven architecture and Kafka. 
- Experience with Git and GitHub. 
- Familiarity with JIRA or similar project-management tools. 
- Good communication and collaboration skills. 
- Ability to actively participate in technical discussions and contribute to team decisions. 
- Positive attitude, willingness to learn, and self-motivated approach. 


Good to Have



- Experience with Microsoft Azure. 
- Experience with Serverless architecture. 
- Experience with Terraform / Infrastructure as Code. 
- Stronger expertise in MongoDB and database performance optimization. 
- Experience with Node.js ecosystem and build/development tools such as:BabelWebpackJestESLintHelm
- Experience with GraphQL tools/frameworks such as Apollo GraphQL or WunderGraph. 
- Experience with event-driven systems and Kafka. 
- Experience with orchestration/automation tools such as n8n. 
- Experience with application monitoring and troubleshooting using Grafana and Loki. 
- Exposure to Kubernetes or other container orchestration platforms. 


Location:

DGS India - Bengaluru - Manyata N1 Block

Brand:

Merkle

Time Type:

Full time

Contract Type:

Permanent#DGS
